Name: Plant Collection
Author: SnPie
Description:
[line]
[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Plant Collection[/b] is a collection tracker for [b]fruit trees, bushes, crops, and flowers[/b].
It scans supported growing locations, player-owned Garden Pots, inventories, and chests to track the plants you currently own. The collection window shows both [b]planted quantities[/b] and the number of [b]saplings or seeds currently in storage[/b].
[b]Crop and flower tracking is enabled by default[/b] and can be disabled through the config file or Generic Mod Config Menu.
Plant Collection supports both vanilla content and compatible custom content added by other mods.[/color]

[line]
[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]

[color=#d4d4d8]1. Install [b]SMAPI 4.5.0 or later[/b].[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]2. Download Plant Collection and extract the archive.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]3. Place the [b]Plant Collection[/b] folder inside your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]4. Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]5.[/color] Load your save and open Plant Collection using the [b]Plant Collection tab on the left side of the inventory menu[/b] or the [b]F2 hotkey[/b], depending on your configuration.

[color=#d4d4d8]When updating the mod, it is recommended to delete the previous Plant Collection folder before installing the new version.[/color]

[line]
[b][size=5]Features[/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Tracks planted [b]fruit trees and bushes[/b] in supported growing locations.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Tracks saplings and seeds stored in player-owned [b]inventories, chests, and supported Garden Pots[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Shows separate quantities for [b]planted[/b] and [b]stored[/b] items.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Crop and flower tracking[/b], enabled by default and configurable through the mod settings. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Tracks planted crops and flowers as well as their seeds stored in inventories and chests.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Supports compatible [b]custom fruit trees, bushes, crops, and flowers[/b] added by other mods.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Automatically updates collection status based on your current save data.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Allows additional growing locations to be manually included or excluded from collection scanning.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Includes SMAPI console commands for checking, including, or excluding the current location.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Separate [b]Trees, Bushes, Crops, and Flowers[/b] tabs with category icons, item tooltips, and scrolling.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Undiscovered items can be hidden using a black silhouette and the name [b]"???"[/b] until discovered. This feature is enabled by default.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Optional configuration for collection categories, UI features, and other mod settings.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]The [b]F2 hotkey[/b] and the [b]Plant Collection inventory menu tab[/b] can be enabled or disabled independently.[/color][/*]
[*]Supports [b][color=#ff7700][size=5]English [/size][/color]and [color=#ff7700][size=5]Korean[/size][/color][/b].[/*]
[/list][heading][line]
[b][size=5]Additional Location Support[/size][/b][/heading]

Plant Collection automatically scans supported growing locations.
For additional modded locations, enable the [b]location toggle button[/b] through config.json or Generic Mod Config Menu.
While visiting a location, use the button displayed in the collection window to manage whether that location should be scanned.

[list]
[*] [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52360/52360-1789731100-164748747.png[/img]  :  The current location is included in collection scanning.[/*]
[*][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52360/52360-1789731188-395887708.png[/img]  :  The current location is excluded from collection scanning.
[/*]
[/list]Click the button to change the location's status.
Location settings are saved [b]per save file[/b].
Automatically supported locations can also be excluded and re-enabled using the same button.

[line]
[b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b]

[color=#d4d4d8][size=4]Required [/size][/color]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]: 4.5.0 or later. [/*]
[/list][size=4]Optional [/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]: [/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]      Allows you to change the hotkey, UI theme, and other settings through an in-game settings menu. [/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13658]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interface[/url]: [/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]      Plant Collection can automatically use an Earthy Interface-compatible UI theme when installed. [/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]Custom Bush[/url]: [/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]      Only required if you want Plant Collection to detect and display compatible custom bushes added through Custom Bush. [/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]: [/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]      Plant Collection supports Lookup Anything for collection entries, including undiscovered items displayed as '???'.[/color]

[size=4][u]Plant Collection works without these optional mods.[/u][/size]

[line]
[b][size=5]Shout-outs[/size][/b]

[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to [b]ConcernedApe[/b] for creating Stardew Valley, and to [b]Pathoschild and the SMAPI contributors[/b] for making Stardew Valley modding possible.
Special thanks to [b]DaisyNiko[/b] for creating Earthy Interface and for allowing Plant Collection to support an Earthy-style UI theme.[/color]
